title: grain/gate@v1: hold a matching change until what it requires is done (docs/task-repos.md §6.3). A gate never fires work except the review tasks it requires, and never relaxes another gate: every gate that matches a change must be satisfied

match.description: Which changes it holds. Paths are repo-relative globs, as grain's path triggers write them. A gate applies to the repo that holds it, read at the target branch's tip, never the change's head; a gate in a mandatory gate source applies to the repos it names (repos:)

repos.description: Only on a gate outside the repos it governs: canonical repo URLs or globs over them. Absent means the gate's own repo

branches.description: Target branches; default the repo's protected refs

requires.description: Everything here must be done before the change may land. Each key only adds a requirement

human.description: A human approver's Submit. when: always (grain's human: required) or on-findings (only if a required review found something)

from.description: Named approvers; default the repo's own approvers (its forge's reviewers, or the owning team's approvers in Silo). Never the change's author, its task's submitter, or the agent or Grain that made it

security_review.description: A security review task, filed on every matching change. Default template: grain's built-in security review

second_review.description: An independent review task, run by a different Grain or model than the one that made the change

sensitive.description: The match is security-sensitive: auto-merge is withdrawn, a security review is required whether or not requires names one, and the change and its run are labelled sensitive (§6.3)
